yt_title: Here lies my saved tab. 156 reels, never opened
caption:
Here lies my saved tab. 🪦
156 reels. Saved with love. Never opened.

SaveSort dug them up: 30 worth doing, 10 straight-up hype, 22 hiding the steps behind "comment GUIDE".

Download your Instagram data (Settings → Accounts Center → Your information and permissions → Download your information → Some of your information → Saved → HTML), then drop the zip into SaveSort. Runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

Sort yours free, link in bio.

#savedreels #instagramtips #productivity #aitools

beats.vo: 156 reels. Saved with love. Never opened.
I'm the tombstone. I've seen things.

beats.caption: Make *$1000 a day* dropshipping
beats.vo: Like this one. A thousand a day? Buried.

beats.caption: Comment *GUIDE* and I'll DM you the steps
beats.vo: Comment guide? The steps were never in the reel.

beats.caption: Claude has a secret *Founder Thinking Mode*
beats.vo: A secret AI mode? Not even a feature. Rest in peace.
But some of them were good.
So I dropped my saves into SaveSort.
30 worth doing. Back from the dead.
65 more said nothing without the video. Also buried.
Even I'm impressed. And I'm made of rock.
Link in bio. Dig yours up before it's too late.
